entities.name: Bill Kouélany
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bill Kouélany is a Congolese artist, writer and set designer. In 2007, she participated in Documenta 12 in Kassel with a multimedia art installation. She lives in Brazzaville, the capital of the Republic of the Congo.
